build_image_processor_conditional_detr: build a ConditionalDetrImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images and COCO annotations for object detection models
preprocess_images_conditional_detr: preprocess a batch of images with COCO detection or panoptic annotations for CONDITIONAL_DETR model input
post_process_object_detection_conditiona: post-process CONDITIONAL_DETR object detection outputs into final bounding boxes filtered by score threshold
post_process_instance_segmentation_condi: post-process CONDITIONAL_DETR segmentation outputs into instance segmentation masks with segment IDs and scores
post_process_panoptic_segmentation_condi: post-process CONDITIONAL_DETR outputs into panoptic segmentation maps with fused semantic and instance labels
